report_metadata.sdlc_rationale: Deadline is fixed (June 30) but requirements details are evolving as HR refines scope, necessitating hybrid approach with sprint cycles within fixed phases.

project_understanding.primary_goal: Create a self-service employee onboarding portal that allows new hires to complete paperwork, set up IT accounts, and meet the team before day one
project_understanding.beneficiary: New employees (100-200/year) and HR team (5 people)
project_understanding.trigger: Onboarding is fragmented - PDF paperwork, manual IT setup, new hires unprepared on day one. CEO asked HR to fix this.
project_understanding.success_definition: New hires complete 80% of tasks before day one, HR admin time reduced 50%, IT setup automated, satisfaction > 4/5
supporting_quotes: CEO asked HR to fix this after hearing complaints at all-hands

assumption_log.what: Workday API provides all required employee data fields (name, start date, department, manager)
assumption_log.why: Project assumes Workday integration is straightforward based on standard API capabilities
assumption_log.pmi_basis: PMBOK 5.4 - Work Breakdown Structure: External dependency should be validated early
assumption_log.consequence: If Workday API limitations exist, manual data entry required, negating automation benefits

assumption_log.what: Azure AD supports all required authentication scenarios including SSO and role-based access
assumption_log.why: Standard enterprise authentication expected to cover HR, IT, Security roles
assumption_log.pmi_basis: PMBOK 8.2 - Quality Management: Authentication is a critical non-functional requirement
assumption_log.consequence: Custom authentication logic needed, extends timeline

assumption_log.what: Document e-signature solution (DocuSign or similar) can be integrated within budget
assumption_log.why: E-signature is standard requirement, multiple vendors available
assumption_log.pmi_basis: PMBOK 11.2 - Risk Identification: Third-party integration risk
assumption_log.consequence: Use PDF-based acknowledgment instead, reduces legal enforceability

critical_path_summary.staffing_implication: Backend developer and frontend developer must be full-time throughout project; designer can be part-time after Phase 2

tasks.name: Stakeholder kickoff meeting
tasks.definition_of_done: Meeting held, notes documented, stakeholders confirmed

tasks.name: Requirements gathering with HR, IT, Security
tasks.definition_of_done: All stakeholder requirements documented and prioritized

tasks.name: UX research and persona definition
tasks.definition_of_done: User personas, journey maps, wireframes complete

tasks.name: Backend API development - authentication
tasks.definition_of_done: Azure AD SSO working, role-based access implemented

tasks.name: Backend API - employee data integration
tasks.definition_of_done: Workday API integrated, employee data syncs correctly

risk_register.description: Workday API changes or rate limits could impact data sync
risk_register.trigger: Workday API returns errors or unexpected data format
risk_register.mitigation: Implement robust error handling, fallback to manual sync if needed, establish communication channel with Workday admin
risk_register.contingency: Manual data import process for critical employee data

risk_register.description: SOC 2 compliance requirements may add significant scope
risk_register.trigger: Security team requests additional controls or audit logging
risk_register.mitigation: Engage security team early in Phase 1, build in 2-week buffer for compliance work
risk_register.contingency: Launch with partial compliance, complete within 30 days post-launch

risk_register.trigger: DocuSign/PandaDoc API integration takes longer than expected
risk_register.mitigation: Start integration in Phase 2, have PDF-only fallback ready
risk_register.contingency: Use PDF acknowledgment with manual signature tracking

open_questions.impact_if_unanswered: Backend integration scope may be larger than estimated

deductions.reason: External dependency (Workday) has HIGH risk if wrong

pm_confidence_score.interpretation: High quality input with clear requirements. Main risks are external integrations. Project is achievable within timeline with appropriate risk mitigation.
